The questions were asked twice; these answer the second version, written after the research in [How wording and missing context shape a reader's response](https://github.com/Zenoctra/factory918/blob/research/wording-and-reader-context/docs/research/wording-and-reader-context.md) was read. Question titles are Claude's:

- Q1: what binds, and who can make it bind
- Q2: how the writer's knowledge of the route is written down
- Q3: what happens to rules that bound how a task is finished (report bars, caps, citation gates)
- Q4: what the reader does when it departs from the route, or a binding rule fights the goal
- Q5: whether cost or time can justify limiting the route

EOF
